rubrics.hi: पेशाब से पहले तेज़ काटने जैसा दर्द होता है और जोर लगाने पर भी पेशाब रुक जाता है।
rubrics.roman: Peshab se pehle tez katne jaisa dard hota hai aur jor lagane par bhi peshab ruk jata hai.

rubrics.path: Bladder, urination, unsatisfactory
rubrics.en: After urinating, you feel as though your bladder is still not fully empty.
rubrics.hi: पेशाब करने के बाद भी संतोष नहीं होता, लगता है पूरा पेशाब नहीं आया।
rubrics.roman: Peshab karne ke baad bhi santosh nahi hota, lagta hai pura peshab nahi aaya.

rubrics.path: Bladder, urination, unsatisfactory, bladder were not emptied, as if, with dribbling
rubrics.en: After urinating, you feel as though your bladder isn't empty and urine continues to dribble out.
rubrics.hi: पेशाब करने के बाद भी लगता है कि मूत्राशय पूरा खाली नहीं हुआ और पेशाब टपकता रहता है।
rubrics.roman: Peshab karne ke baad bhi lagta hai ki mootrashay pura khali nahi hua aur peshab tapkta rehta hai.

rubrics.path: Bladder, urination, unsatisfactory, feeling as if urine remained in urethra
rubrics.en: After urinating, you feel as if some urine is still left sitting in the tube you urinate through.
rubrics.hi: पेशाब के बाद लगता है जैसे पेशाब की नली में कुछ पेशाब अटका रह गया है।
rubrics.roman: Peshab ke baad lagta hai jaise peshab ki nali mein kuch peshab atka reh gaya hai.

rubrics.path: Bladder, urination, involuntary, mania, during
rubrics.en: You leak urine without meaning to during a period of mania or mental agitation.
rubrics.hi: पागलपन (मानसिक उन्माद) के दौरान पेशाब अपने आप निकल जाता है।
rubrics.roman: Paagalpan ke dौran peshaab apne aap nikal jata hai.

rubrics.path: Bladder, urination, unconscious, urethra insensible, mania in
rubrics.en: During episodes of mania, urine passes without your awareness because you have no sensation in the tube you urinate through.
rubrics.hi: पागलपन (मानसिक उन्माद) की अवस्था में पेशाब की नली को पेशाब जाने का एहसास नहीं होता।
rubrics.roman: Pagalpan mansik unmad ki avastha mein peshab ki nali ko peshab jane ka ehsaas nahi hota.

rubrics.path: Bladder, urination, unconscious, urethra insensible, mania in, urine and stool
rubrics.en: During episodes of mania, both urine and stool pass without your awareness because you have no sensation in the tube you urinate through.
rubrics.hi: पागलपन (मानसिक उन्माद) की अवस्था में पेशाब और मल दोनों बिना एहसास के निकल जाते हैं।
rubrics.roman: Pagalpan mansik unmad ki avastha mein peshab aur mal donon bina ehsaas ke nikal jate hain.

rubrics.path: Bladder, weakness, evening
rubrics.en: In the evening, your bladder feels weak.
rubrics.hi: शाम के समय मूत्राशय कमज़ोर हो जाता है।
rubrics.roman: Shaam ke samay mootrashay kamzor ho jata hai.

rubrics.path: Bladder, weakness, old people
rubrics.en: Your bladder feels weak, as is common in older people.
rubrics.hi: बुजुर्गों में मूत्राशय कमज़ोर हो जाता है।
rubrics.roman: Bujurgon mein mootrashay kamzor ho jata hai.

rubrics.path: Bladder, weakness, parturition, after
rubrics.en: Your bladder has felt weak since giving birth.
rubrics.hi: प्रसव (बच्चा होने) के बाद मूत्राशय कमज़ोर हो गया है।
rubrics.roman: Prasav bacha hone ke baad mootrashay kamzor ho gaya hai.

rubrics.path: Bladder, weakness, sphincter
rubrics.en: The muscle that keeps your bladder closed feels weak.
rubrics.hi: पेशाब रोकने वाली मांसपेशी (स्फिंक्टर) कमज़ोर हो गई है।
rubrics.roman: Peshab rokne wali mansapeshi sphincter kamzor ho gayi hai.
